node.title: E22 minimal-scale class partition
node.statement: For dyadic E22 support-scale data, the classes with at least one admissible quotient modulus decompose disjointly by their unique minimal admissible modulus. Equivalently, the tail-minimal predicates from e22_minimal_scale_tail_criterion form a disjoint partition of the selected canonical representatives.
node.attack_surface: finite-chain partition induced by the dyadic minimal-scale selector
node.falsifier: a dyadic support class with two different minimal admissible moduli, or with an admissible modulus but no tail-minimal partition cell
